Line 49: role label uses text-tapasya-blue on a bg-tapasya-blue sidebar — text is invisible (blue on blue). Change to text-white or text-white/80.
hover:bg-tapasya-blue is identical to base bg-tapasya-blue — button has no visible hover state. Use a darker/lighter blue for hover (e.g. hover:bg-blue-700).
login error uses text-tapasya-blue instead of a red/destructive color. Users may miss error feedback since blue reads as informational.

Line 133 save button hover:bg-tapasya-blue == base color (no hover feedback). Line 137 delete button hover:bg-tapasya-blue reuses the primary color for a destructive action — consider a red/destructive hover for delete.
